info.name: OCR Flow
info.summary: Send files to the OCR pipeline (tesseract + Surya VLM) from the Files context menu
info.description: Adds a "Send to OCR" action to the Files context menu (single and multi-select). Files are queued to the nc-ocr-flow service running on the same host; progress is visible at /panel on port 8095.
info.author: Likivik
